scope: Independent actual-pixel coverage audit of assigned primaryB and supplementalS05/S08. Other primary/supplemental/history sources are being audited by root and behind_panel_recall; this is not a full-corpus freeze.

sources_actually_inspected.finding: Large unarmored white/polar bears are attacked, have health bars, drop meat, and are targeted by camp defenses. Red-clad axe carriers are purchased workers, not enemy evidence.

Opening cyan HELP figures are freezing survivors who thaw into workers. Late43.5–49s shows large white quadrupedal hostiles with dark dorsal spikes/plates, red health bars, and pursuit/defense interactions.

Small red-hooded skull-faced/masked attackers and larger matching bosses attack camp. Damage flashes are not separate types. Final bear promotional shot supports the polar-bear family; its size/camera does not by itself establish another tier.

distinctive_features: White fur, rounded ears, long muzzle, black nose and claws
No harness or ice armor; health bars and meat drops in primary B
